description: DJI202102_S003 is a search-only LDDH-attributed lead. Its search-result title/report date is 28 February, while the excerpt says a demonstration preceded arrests; the physical occurrence and start date are not established. The Palace location is excerpt-level only. A fresh exact-URL request returned a technical cache miss with no body or HTTP status.
required_followup: If revisited, obtain a verified body through a fresh exact-URL access receipt, complete saved publisher/origin review and immediate full-input path/hash recheck. Do not infer event onset from the publication heading or retry through alternate copies.

description: January sources describe separate RADDE weekly gatherings, including a January 23 Boulaos demonstration against a fifth presidential term. February searches did not establish a physical continuation of any January assembly or confirm a February gathering in that series. A recurring campaign is not coded as one uninterrupted event. DJI202102_S004 is January boundary context only; its exact URL was body-read in the January unit as DJ202101-S007.
required_followup: Keep January event ownership unchanged. Reopen the boundary only if dated February evidence establishes a distinct gathering or a particular uninterrupted episode; do not infer continuation from search silence.

description: The bounded first pass captured 12 actual batched search invocations and 274 ordered result headers, with no provider totals. Queries covered English, French, Arabic and Somali, generic and week-window terms, local and official sources, rights organizations, sectors, geography and January-to-February continuity. Open-web coverage does not reproduce LexisNexis; systematic press archives and complete local-language coverage were unavailable, so no-event searches do not establish absence.
required_followup: Treat findings as an open-web first pass only; compare with systematic archives and the official baseline before any final unit conclusion.
